svg.title: Backpropagation: regression vs classification
svg.desc: Two parallel flowcharts showing how loss is calculated and weights are updated for regression (MSE loss) and classification (cross-entropy loss), from forward pass through backpropagation to weight update.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during the forward pass in a regression network?')
g.text: ŷ = σ( W · x + b ) — any real number

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during the forward pass in a classification network?')
sendPrompt('Why does regression output a single number?')
sendPrompt('Why does classification output a probability vector?')
sendPrompt('Explain MSE loss in regression with an example')
sendPrompt('Explain binary cross-entropy loss with an example')
sendPrompt('Walk me through a numeric MSE loss calculation step by step')
sendPrompt('Walk me through a numeric cross-entropy loss calculation step by step')

svg.text: — step 1: gradient of loss w.r.t. output —

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the gradient of MSE calculated w.r.t. the output?')
g.text: sign tells direction, size tells how much

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the gradient of cross-entropy loss calculated w.r.t. the output?')
g.text: how far predicted prob is from true label

svg.text: — step 2: chain rule back through each layer —

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the chain rule in backpropagation')
g.text: same for both regression and classification

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the chain rule in backpropagation')
g.text: same for both regression and classification

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the gradient descent weight update rule')
g.text: move W opposite to gradient direction

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the gradient descent weight update rule')
sendPrompt('How do I know when a regression model has converged?')
g.text: monitor val loss; stop when plateau

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I know when a classification model has converged?')
g.text: Converged when CE loss is small
monitor val accuracy + loss; stop at plateau

svg.text: What differs: loss function + output activation (linear vs softmax) — backprop + weight update rule are identical
